verdict.rationale: Compatibility promises and upgrade guides are a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code CLI and SDK platform. The pack has no versioning policy, backward-compatibility guarantee, changelog, or release-to-release upgrade guide. The migration and import docs cover moving from Terraform or CloudFormation and adopting existing resources, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on documented compatibility promises and upgrade guides between releases
